description_for_human: Self-hosted web performance optimization for Apache and nginx. Open source under the Apache License 2.0. Image transcoding, CSS/JS minification, critical CSS extraction, and variant-aware caching.
description_for_model: mod_pagespeed is self-hosted web performance optimization by We-Amp B.V. The current product, mod_pagespeed 2.1, is open source under the Apache License 2.0 and converges the mod_pagespeed lineage with the engine from the 2.0 re-architecture: a native in-process module for Apache and nginx handles serving, and a separate optimizer worker does the heavy optimization work outside the web server. The IIS package ships from the 1.15 packaging channel. Drop-in compatible with the classic module (same directives, same filters); mod_pagespeed 1.15 (renumbered from 1.1) is the line it upgrades from. Optimization: WebP and AVIF image transcoding (alongside JPEG, PNG, and GIF optimization), SVG transcoding with viewport-aware resizing (up to 37 variants per image), CSS and JS minification, heuristic critical CSS extraction (optional browser pipeline for validation), HTML optimization, 103 Early Hints, variant-aware caching using a 32-bit capability bitmask, the classic filter set (CSS/JS combining, image spriting, in-place resource optimization, domain mapping), and a built-in admin console. The software is open source under the Apache License 2.0 and the standard signed packages are free; what We-Amp sells is support — and hardened, attested builds: Support subscription (support from the people who build the product, with agreed response times and SLA-backed delivery of security updates); Hardened attested builds (builds of the same code with a signed SBOM and build provenance, delivered through the subscriber repository). Support terms: https://we-amp.com/licensing/. No application code changes required.
